name: Winix 5510
summary: The app-connected successor to the Winix 5500-2, rated for 392 sq ft by AHAM. It packs studio-sized cleaning into the slimmest full-size body here, but it's loud at top speed and Winix publishes few specs or warranty terms.
idealFor: Studios around 400 sq ft with a narrow spot by a wall or desk
Buyers who want the 5500-2's performance with an app
pros: AHAM room rating of 392 sq ft; HouseFresh measured 249 cfm (PM1)
Slim body: about 13.6 × 8.3 in on the floor
PlasmaWave ionizer can be switched off
cons: Loud at top speed: 67.2 dBA at 3 ft in HouseFresh's tests
Auto mode relies on an odor sensor and may ignore dust and pollen (Air Purifier First)
New Filter Q set doesn't fit the older 5500-2

trust.summary: Two independent hands-on reviews agree it cleans a studio-sized room quickly, and their measurements match the AHAM rating. Winix's own page lists no dimensions, weight or noise figures and no warranty terms beyond '2-year warranty'. Its CARB certification is on the state's public list, and there are no CPSC recalls for the brand.

sources.title: HouseFresh: Winix 5510 review
sources.note: Danny Ashton, Oct 2026, bought with own money. PM1 CADR about 249 cfm at top, 125 under 45 dBA; test room cleared in 24 min; 35.2–67.2 dBA at 3 ft; filters about $80 a year
